V. 21.
Jeſus looking upon him—And looking into his Heart, loved him—Doubtleſs for the Dawnings of Good which he ſaw in him: And ſaid to him—Out of tender Love One thing thou lackeſt— The Love of GOD, without which all Religion is a dead Carcaſe. In order to this, throw away what is to thee the grand Hinderance of it. Give up thy great Idol Riches. Go, ſ•ll whatſoever thou haſt.
